hero.headline: Let's start a conversation.
hero.text: Have a project, partnership idea, institutional enquiry, or question about what we do? We would love to hear from you.

successMessage: Thank you for contacting Edunotech. Your message has been received. Our team will review your enquiry and get back to you.

direct.heading: Not sure where to start?
direct.text: Tell us a little about what you are trying to achieve, and we will help direct your enquiry to the appropriate area.
